    ['python', '-c', r'''

# `<test>`
"""

html = md.convert(md_text)

print("TOC tokens:")
for t in md.toc_tokens:
    print(f"  {t}")

print("\nFull HTML:")
print(html)
'''],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='.'
)

if result.stderr:
